title: Split a bill across several cards
body: Group bookings want to pay with one card each. Adds splitBill and chargeSplit, which charges every card its share.

labels.note: Every share is Math.round(total / people), so the shares do not add up to the total whenever it does not divide evenly. 100.00 across 3 cards charges 3 x 33.33 = 99.99, and 0.05 across 2 charges 2 x 0.03 = 0.06. The docstring promises an exact sum; the remainder cents must go to some of the shares.
